calculation.description: Fade the prior three-session return, with a larger reversal score after an unusually high-volume prior session. Signals use only completed bars and are ranked cross-sectionally.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC across the available 2026 sample; 5d and 10d IC were also positive. Small effective cross-section and incomplete volume coverage require conservative monitoring.
